personality_one_liner: Professional, trust-instilling enterprise catalog that prioritizes clarity, structural discipline, and high-quality asset presentation without gimmicky colors.

spacing.rule: Handle spacing correctly dont have extra spaces where its not required, handle padding and margin corectly and subtle for buttons and components

do's: Avoid glassmorphism for this enterprise banking app to maintain strict functional clarity and high contrast
dont's: Do not use blur or frosted glass over cards, headers, or bottom sheets

screens.name: Public Catalog
screens.purpose: A browseable, card-based marketplace for prospective buyers to find auction assets.

states.loading: Skeleton grids representing the property cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a magnifying glass over a house, text 'No assets found', button 'Clear Filters'.
states.error: Text 'Unable to load assets' with 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Sticky search and cascaded location filter pills at the top. Two-column grid of asset cards with edge-to-edge images, bold prices, and gold/orange 'Auction Schedule' status badges overlaid. Key specifications (bedrooms, type) shown via small icons under the price.

screens.name: Asset Detail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive view of a single asset leading to a direct WhatsApp contact action.

states.loading: Skeleton of hero image and text blocks.
states.error: Text 'Asset details unavailable' with 'Go Back' button.

screens.layout: Large hero photo gallery at the top (gradient scrim at the bottom). Clean sections for property details, location map, and auction timeline. A persistent, sticky 'Contact PIC (WhatsApp)' button anchored at the bottom inside a safe-area container.

screens.name: Internal Login
screens.purpose: Secure entry point for Marketing Asset, ACRM, and Admin RCG roles.

states.error: Inline text 'Invalid credentials' in error color.

screens.layout: Minimalist centered layout on surfaceSecondary. BSI logo at the top. Single-column input fields with labels above. Primary login button at the bottom of the form.

screens.name: Role Dashboard
screens.purpose: Hub for internal roles showing quick statistics and their current action queue.

states.loading: Skeleton statistic cards and list items.
states.empty: Illustration of an empty inbox, text 'All caught up! No assets in queue'.
states.error: Text 'Could not fetch dashboard data' with 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Top section with stat cards (e.g., 'Pending Review', 'Approved', 'Total Published'). Below, a segmented control or tabs for queue status. List view of asset items with strict approval status badges and timeline tracking.

screens.name: Add Asset Wizard
screens.purpose: A multi-step form for the Maker role to input new asset details systematically.

states.loading: Spinner when saving draft or submitting the final step.
states.error: Toast or inline validation errors on required fields.

screens.layout: Progress indicator at the top. Each step uses a single-column layout for form inputs (Accordion menus for grouped data). Sticky 'Next'/'Submit' button at the bottom. Use progressive disclosure to prevent overwhelming the user.

screens.name: Approval Review
screens.purpose: Screen for Checker/Controller roles to review an asset submission and take action.
screens.layout: Full read-only asset detail view with an added 'Audit Timeline' section showing maker notes. Sticky bottom bar with two primary actions side-by-side: a 'Return' button (secondary/outline) and an 'Approve' button (primary green).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: Primary is #00A0A0 (Green/Teal), Secondary is #F0B43C (Gold/Orange). Avoid blue everywhere.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' to maintain a highly readable, professional enterprise aesthetic.
Implement the Maker-Checker-Controller workflow with distinct role dashboards and explicit approval actions.
Apply progressive disclosure in the Add Asset Wizard. Avoid long scrolling forms by separating into logical steps (e.g., General, Details, Photos, Pricing).
Ensure the Public Catalog utilizes a board-style (2-column) card layout with edge-to-edge images and bolded prices to highlight the assets.
Place a persistent sticky CTA (e.g., 'Contact WhatsApp', 'Approve/Return') at the bottom of detail and form screens.
Do not use glassmorphism effects; stick to solid surfaces and subtle shadows to preserve the 'banking enterprise' feel and maintain maximum contrast.
